build_contacts_net: build a ContactsNet instance to predict C-beta contacts from protein sequence features
compute_outputs_contacts_net: compute the network output logits for contact prediction given 1D and 2D input embeddings
build_2d_embedding: build a 2D embedding by concatenating 1D features with pairwise residue offsets and binary position codes
quant_threshold_contacts_net: find the distance histogram bin index corresponding to a given angstrom threshold for contact probability
build_crops_biases: build position-specific bias tensors reshaped to match crop regions for contact prediction logits
